items.zh: 黎曼猜想
items.en: The Riemann Hypothesis.
items.note: A mathematician at Anthropic claims to have proved the Riemann Hypothesis and its generalization by collaborating with the AI model Claude. The proof consists of a 250,000-page text and formalized code verified by a tool called Lean, which checks logical steps but does not guarantee semantic alignment with the original problem. Experts note that the mathematical community needs time to verify the work and that the formalization process has known historical limitations.

sources.name: IT Home
sources.title: 黎曼猜想真被 Claude 证明了？Anthropic 数学家仅发布 Lean 代码，陶哲轩称验证仍需时间
sources.titleEn: Did Claude prove the Riemann Hypothesis? Anthropic mathematician releases only Lean code; Terence Tao says verification will take time

items.more: The claim was made on November 20, shortly after Anthropic went public, which the mathematician admitted was a poor timing choice. Verification requires peer-reviewed publication and a two-year waiting period set by the Clay Mathematics Institute to qualify for the $1 million prize. Initial checks by some mathematicians confirm the Lean code addresses the correct conjecture, though concerns remain about potential kernel flaws in the verification software.

reception.en: Mathematician Terence Tao provided a preliminary analysis, noting the proof uses modern arithmetic geometry and will take time to verify. Professor Alex Kontorovich expressed increased confidence in the proof's success because it utilizes extensive mathematical tools.

items.zh: APEC盛会效应拉满

items.note: Zheng Hanzhen, vice president of Australian Capital Investment Company, spoke at the APEC Business Leaders Summit in Shenzhen about deepening cross-border investment and industrial synergy in the Asia-Pacific region. He highlighted how China's technological and manufacturing strengths complement other economies, such as Australia's resource endowments and Singapore's financial networks. The article presents his view that mature industrial ecosystems, particularly in sectors like semiconductors and green energy, offer better long-term investment stability than short-term market trends.

items.zh: 美股科技股开盘集体下挫
items.en: US tech stocks open collectively lower
items.note: Nvidia's stock dropped 14%, marking its seventh consecutive weekly decline and wiping out nearly half its market value from recent highs. This sell-off was triggered by CEO Jensen Huang's resignation following a personal scandal, which overshadowed the company's better-than-expected financial results. The broader technology sector also suffered significant losses, with major indices and AI-related stocks falling sharply as investors questioned the sustainability of high valuations and capital spending.

sources.titleEn: Nvidia's market cap has shrunk by $2.73 trillion from its October high, equivalent to losing one Amazon, as the Nasdaq posted its worst single-week performance since March 2020 amid the pandemic

items.more: Nvidia's market capitalization has fallen to approximately $3.03 trillion, a decrease of over $2.73 trillion from its peak of $5.76 trillion. The Nasdaq 100 index experienced its worst single-week performance since March 2020, while the VIX volatility index reached its highest level this year. Market sentiment has shifted due to concerns over AI profitability, leadership instability, and rising interest rates, with traders now expecting a Federal Reserve rate hike in December.

items.zh: 两大千禧年数学难题被AI攻克了吗
items.en: Have two Millennium Prize mathematical problems been solved by AI?
items.note: A mathematician at Anthropic claims to have solved the Riemann Hypothesis, one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems, by collaborating with the AI model Claude. The proof consists of over 250,000 pages of text and millions of lines of formalized code, which have not been fully published. Experts are cautiously analyzing the work, noting that while the formalization appears correct, the mathematical community needs time to verify the underlying logic.

sources.title: 黎曼猜想真被 Claude 证明了？Anthropic 数学家仅发布 Lean 代码，陶哲轩称验证仍需时间
sources.titleEn: Did Claude really prove the Riemann Hypothesis? Anthropic mathematician only released Lean code, Terence Tao says verification will take time

items.more: The claim was made on November 20, with the mathematician stating he finished the key work on November 15-16. The proof relies on modern results from the Langlands program and arithmetic geometry. To be eligible for the $1 million prize, the solution must be published in a peer-reviewed journal and withstand at least two years of verification by the mathematical community.

items.zh: UP主解读AI声称证明黎曼猜想
items.en: Content creator analyzes AI's claim to have proven the Riemann Hypothesis
items.note: A mathematician at Anthropic claims to have proven the Riemann Hypothesis with the help of the AI model Claude, releasing extensive formalized code for verification. The article notes that while experts have begun preliminary checks, the mathematical community requires a lengthy peer-review process before accepting the result. It highlights concerns about AI reliability and the specific rules set by the Clay Mathematics Institute for awarding the prize.

sources.name: IT Home
sources.title: 黎曼猜想真被 Claude 证明了？Anthropic 数学家仅发布 Lean 代码，陶哲轩称验证仍需时间
sources.titleEn: Was the Riemann Hypothesis really proven by Claude? Anthropic mathematician only released Lean code, Terence Tao says verification still takes time

items.more: Levent Alpöge, who holds degrees from Harvard and Princeton, stated the proof involves over 250,000 pages of text and 17 million lines of Lean code, a system used to mechanically verify logical derivations. The Clay Mathematics Institute requires a two-year verification period and publication in a peer-reviewed journal, meaning the current submission does not qualify for the $1 million prize. Alpöge admitted the timing of the announcement was poor because it occurred shortly after Anthropic's stock market listing.

items.zh: 当我用AI续写爱情公寓4关谷悠悠婚礼【AI全民制作人】
items.en: When I used AI to continue writing the Guanyu and Youyou wedding scene from Love Apartment 4 [AI National Producer]

video.about: The video uses AI to write a continuation of the wedding scene for Guan Gu and Youyou from the show iPartment. The uploader states the goal is to give the couple a happy ending and provide comfort to fans.

reception.en: Viewers praise the AI continuation as superior to the official series finale, though some note that while the dialogue is convincing, the AI cannot replicate the actors' natural speech pauses. There is also a specific disagreement regarding the accuracy of Hu Yifei's portrayal in the wedding scene. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“Much better than the messy Zhuge Dali”
reception.zh: 比什么乱七八糟的 诸葛大力强多了

reception.en: “AI fills lines but not their speech pauses”
reception.zh: AI 补的是台词，补不回他们说话的停顿

comments.gist: The commenter states that this AI continuation is better than the official character Zhuge Dali.
The commenter observes that while the AI reproduces dialogue, it fails to capture the actors' natural pauses, yet they watched until the end despite knowing who was absent.

The commenter notes that viewers argued over whether a specific line sounded like Hu Yifei, arguing that AI often writes what audiences want to hear rather than what the character would actually say, and they reserve judgment on the wedding scene.
